author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Demo announcement trailer for murmures, a narrative exploration game about what we do with our emotions when we spend most of our time trying to keep them under control. murmures will be available on PC. A demo is coming to Steam on November 9, 2026. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4963020/murmures/
title: murmures - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Ctrl-U: Testing Facility, an upcoming platform parkour FPS where every second counts. Fine-tune the K-Series Auxiliary Android prototype through increasingly challenging test courses, facing obstacles and enemies that will put your speed and efficiency to the test. Ctrl-U: Testing Facility will be available soon on PC (Steam). 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4758850/CTRLU_Testing_Facility/
title: Ctrl-U: Testing Facility - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Fantasy Camp Builder, cozy medieval-fantasy camp-building game developed by Myth Archer Studio. Design your own relaxing campsite by placing tents, campfires, wooden furniture, lanterns, food, tools, ornaments, and other decorations. Arrange each object freely to build warm, lived-in spaces that feel like a quiet stop on a magical journey. Fantasy Camp Builder will be available on PC (Steam) on November 20, 2026: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4913950/Fantasy_Camp_Builder/
title: Fantasy Camp Builder - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Tiebreakers, an upcoming hand-crafted 2D shonen run 'n gun that replaces guns with sport! This trailer reveals one of the main characters Li Sha as she battles her way with ping pong balls, bowling balls and takes on one of the villainous Red Cards. Tiebreakers will be available on Steam in Q3 2027. Consoles to be announced.
title: Tiebreakers - Official Reveal Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Survive and explore an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers, the upcoming open-world survival crafting adventure developed and published by Crema. Check out the extended announcement trailer for Temtem: Pioneers. Temtem Pioneers will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) in Q4 2028.

In Temtem: Pioneers, venture into the wild solo or team up in online co-op with friends. Tame, command, and play as a roster of over 200 Temtem, mastering their distinct skills and synergies in fast-paced, real-time action combat. Build your settlement, gather resources, craft gear, and carve out a home across a dangerous, untamed landscape.
title: Temtem: Pioneers - Official Extended Announcement Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay and more from Cathedral: Crow's Curse in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game set in the same universe as Cathedral. Cathedral: Crow's Curse features tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge, and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich, detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral. Cathedral: Crow's Curse will be available on PC (Linux, OSX, and Windows on Steam and GOG), PlayStation 4 (PS4), and Nintendo Switch in 2027.
title: Cathedral: Crow's Curse - Official Demo Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the characters of Psycho-Sleuth in this launch trailer, and get a peek at this psychological mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. Psycho-Sleuth is available now on PC via Steam, STOVE, and Epic Games Store.

In Psycho-Sleuth, thirteen “Afflicted Ones,” each with a reality-bending cognitive disorder, face a grim trial when a cult known as Li traps them in a gothic cathedral. If one of them can get away with murder without getting caught, they earn godhood.
title: Psycho-Sleuth - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the PS5 Release Date Trailer for Popucom, a match-3 adventure platformer developed by Hypergryph. Players will navigate an unknown planet to overcome challenges, solve puzzles, and face enemies along the way. Popucom is launching on November 17 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), with the game being available now for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Popucom - Official PS5 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Rally Shift, a sci-fi driving game developed by Abstract Pixel Studios. Players will drive to stay alive as a live bomb is on their dash and an alien is on their tail. Master driving mechanics before time runs out in Rally Shift, launching on November 10 for PC (Steam).
title: Rally Shift - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Early Access Release Window Trailer for The Citadel Project, a first-person stealth survival horror game developed by Reliquary Software. Players will fight through a dark fantasy world to stay hidden in the shadows, make use of an array of tools and weapons, and seek the truth behind the downfall of the Citadel. The Citadel Project is launching into Early Access in November 2026 for PC (Steam).
title: The Citadel Project - Official Early Access Release Window Trailer
